This functionality requires low level manipulation of editor camera poses (due to ambiguity about implied rotation centers).  libspnav is an relatively elegant software interface and would support a huge range of spacemice for a reasonable amount of code.

This feature was attempted as a plugin in godot 3.4, and the developer struggled with missing interfaces at the plugin level.  The plugin has broken with the update to 4.x
https://github.com/cybereality/godot-space-mouse

Someone forked for 4.2, but is a work in progress and only tested on windows
https://github.com/MrVolans/godot-4.2-space-mouse
